note: Words the offline patient listens for in Chinese, for every patient (scripts/core/scripted_brain.gd topic_for_text). Chinese has no spaces, so a word counts wherever it appears in the typed line: one point for each word of a topic, added to the English keys' score; the highest score wins and a tie goes to the topic the case lists first. Like the English keys, the words leave out bare question words (why: 为什么), which would pull every question to one topic, and single characters that sit inside everyday words (气 in 天气). A case's own words are in its catalog's topics (<case>:<topic>), and a word in both lists counts twice. Nothing here is shown, so strings stays empty.
